text:
The shell, yes. A floor full of life, on bigger rope.

So, leave it up? The shell, frame and skin, 2,695 kilograms, hangs from this X on 5/8 in rope at 34 kilonewtons, the trees guyed. Add a floor and what a household puts on it, by the cell wall's own figure 3.3 tonnes, and it is 6.0 tonnes, pulling 75 kilonewtons: 1 in rope, and every guy and tree checked again. It can be done. It is a structure an engineer and an arborist should sign, and it is priced here, not rated.
